Context: 1. Voluntary Retirement

2. If a Government servant on account of hardship faced due to disability applies for voluntary retirement on medical grounds without knowing the protection provided by the Section 47 of the PwD Act, 1955, the superior officers should explain the correct legal position and the legal rights available under Section 47 so as to enable to take a correct decision to continue in service or apply for voluntary retirement. - Rule 43 (5).
